LightningComponentBundle.description: Embeds the WaveMaker app (employeeapp UI Bundle, package-free embedding bridge) with lightning-ui-embedding and shares Employee Directory data with it.

property.name: appName
property.label: UI Bundle name
property.description: API name of the UI Bundle that serves the WaveMaker app. Used to derive https://mydomain--c.instance.my.salesforce.app/app/c__NAME when Employee App URL is blank.

property.name: employeeAppUrl
property.label: Employee App URL
property.description: Optional: https URL of the WaveMaker app / employeeapp UI Bundle (copy it from the address bar after opening employeeapp from the App Launcher). Leave blank to derive it from the current org.
